reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

description.narrative: Malawi, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Malawi (MOH)This program has the following goals: To eliminate malaria in Malawi by 2030. The objectives of this program are: To increase the proportion of population protected by at least one malaria vector control interventions from 37% in 2022 to at least 90% by 2030. To increase and sustain the proportion of suspected cases of malaria that are tested from 98% in 2022 to 100% and treat all the confirmed cases by 2030. To sustain annual average stock out rate of less than 1% for all malaria first-line treatment throughout the MSP (2023-2030) period. viii. To improve malaria data quality from 94% in 2022 to 99% by 2030 to ensure evidence-based program implementation, policy direction and accountability at all levels of health service delivery
